subject: Quantix availability alert & executive update
messages:
From: Quantix Ops <support@quantix.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quantix - API timeouts and 500s (Feb 14)

Hi team,

We started seeing a spike in API 500s and timeouts across a subset of our production traffic at 09:05 PST. Error rate has climbed to ~18% for requests routed to "redwood-infer-prod-1" and some customers are reporting failed requests.

Key details:
- First observed: 09:05 PST
- Affected region: us-west-2 endpoints
- Symptoms: 500 responses, long tail latency, some retries succeed
- Impact: degraded throughput for our real-time scoring pipeline (affects our retail pricing feature)

Can you confirm receipt and advise ETA on remediation? We're preparing an internal exec note and need an update within 30 minutes.

Thanks,
Elaine Cho
Head of Platform Operations
Quantix Data Systems
support@quantix.com

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:18:10 -0800
Subject: Re: Quantix - API timeouts and 500s (Feb 14)

Acknowledged — thanks for flagging, Elaine. Marcus/Hannah/Monica: please join a brief bridge and triage. Marcus, can you own customer comms and I'll coordinate the exec update? Hannah, please paste initial triage notes to the bridge and attach any logs. Monica, loop CS if customers need credits or immediate mitigation.

Proposed bridge: Zoom link in related_links, start in 5 minutes. I'll draft a high-level executive snapshot once we have the impact estimate.

Irene

Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:24:45 -0800
Subject: Triage notes: Quantix outage - initial findings

On Sun, Feb 14, 2027 at 09:18 AM PST Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com> wrote:
> Acknowledged — thanks for flagging, Elaine. Marcus/Hannah/Monica: please join a brief bridge and triage.

Bridge is up. Initial findings:
- Symptoms reproduce for requests with long context lengths and when model variant r-infer-v3 is selected.
- Errors from runtime show GC stalls on 1-2 nodes and slow disk I/O on node pool redwood-prod-gpu-14.
- We are currently re-routing a subset of traffic to r-infer-v2 and spinning up additional nodes in us-west-2.

Attachments: logs.zip (sample error traces), incident_timeline.csv (timeline v0.1).

Immediate mitigation: traffic reroute to r-infer-v2 reduced error rate to ~4% for the affected customers; still watching. Suspect kernel-level IO contention during checkpoint write.

Will update with next diagnostics in 15 minutes.

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Site Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Cho <elaine.cho@quantix.com>, Quantix Ops <ops@quantix.com>, support@quantix.com
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:40:02 -0800
Subject: Quantix — availability update (executive snapshot)

Elaine —

Thank you for the prompt alert and patience while we triaged. Below is a concise executive snapshot to share with your leadership.

Summary:
- Impact: Elevated 500 responses and increased latency for a subset of real-time scoring requests using model r-infer-v3 in us-west-2. Peak error rate ~18% starting 09:05 PST.
- Mitigation in place: We rerouted affected traffic to r-infer-v2 and provisioned additional capacity; observed error rate drop to ~4% as of 09:36 PST.
- Customer impact: Quantix reported degradations to real-time pricing; engineering teams may have experienced timeouts and degraded throughput.

Root-cause (initial):
- Preliminary indicators point to IO contention on a small subset of GPU nodes during background checkpointing which caused GC-like stalls in the runtime. Full root cause pending deeper kernel-level analysis.

Actions we have taken and next steps:
1) Immediate — traffic reroute and scale-up (complete)
2) Short term — stabilize nodes and apply IO throttling to checkpoint jobs (in progress)
3) Post-incident — full postmortem and remediation plan with timeline (we will propose a sync)

Timeline & commit:
- 09:05 PST — first customer report
- 09:10 PST — internal bridge established
- 09:36 PST — mitigation (reroute) reduced error rate to ~4%
- Next update: 10:15 PST with diagnostic artifacts and a proposed postmortem schedule

We recognize the impact to your customers and apologize for the disruption. We will share the incident timeline and a full action plan in the postmortem. In the meantime, if you need a dedicated briefing for your execs, I'm available on the bridge now or can join a separate call.

Regards,

Irene Choi
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0163
irene@redwood.com
Attachment: exec_brief.pdf (high-level slide summary)
